surgical: Omni answer on last 10 s of video, if available

anesthesia.gist: MAP fell within about 90 s of a propofol increase with propofol and remifentanil running; HR flat to low, not rising.

record.gist: Losartan taken this morning; this drug class is associated with low pressure under anaesthesia. Also on apixaban (last dose 19 h ago), with no surgical signal reported.
